articles.title: The UK needs a workable route to regulated DeFi access
articles.snippet: The UK’s 2027 crypto rules risk a de facto ban on regulated firms providing access to DeFi, argues Coinbase’s European policy head Katie Harries.

articles.title: Italy Busts Mafia 'Secret Bank' That Laundered Money Through Crypto, Seizes $24M
articles.snippet: Police say a car-rental firm near Milan was an underground bank for 'Ndrangheta and Camorra figures, moving money abroad and into crypto.

articles.title: UK Banks Hit With 10,000 Complaints Over Blocked Crypto Transfers in 90 Days: Report
articles.snippet: Lloyds drew the most complaints despite having no published policy restricting crypto transfers, according to a Stand With Crypto report.

articles.title: The Midterms Are the First Real Test of Whether Markets Beat Pollsters
articles.snippet: Former NBC News political director Chuck Todd is hosting NEXTPredict two weeks before the vote, and has yet to pick a side.
